contract: Tamer research + summons + treats (docs/design/tamer_server_2026-10-12.md §1-§4, crafting_market §4, A23-115; PetService.SummonPet / HasRoom / GetPet / AddPetXP, PetList Roll, the 64-pet cap before a pet goes in; FeedPet(uid): a ready owner's pet below MaxLv, one Pet Treat -> +20 pet XP, keys only, 0.5 s). Research: switch Config.Features.Research off; the tamer (artisan Archer, class picked) gets 1 point per paid kill (not MinorShare; auto too) in Config.MonsterFamily (every slime = Slime); stages 50/150/400/1000/2500, one keyed line per new stage (named families), StageUp signal; TamerInfo { Pts, Stage, Sum, Stages } at join and after changes (once a second, a new stage / summon at once); 64 families, MaxCount; AddSummon.
limitations: The summon / Pet Treat recipes are tested in tools/test_craft.py (PetService / TamerService doubles there); the Roll walk speed in tools/test_pet_speed.py; the research window, the summon result and the Feed button (PetWindow: Roll in its speed number) are client work.
